verified_scientific_accounting.constructed_response: Positive regular G1 total optical potential and separately specified quadratic remainder, exact foreground-deflected G1 center, full original two-plane action and ordered nonsymmetric image Jacobian; no image-specific correction or extra BHSM optical amplitude.
verified_scientific_accounting.conditional_development_fit: Final Gaia Q/RMS values match the final exact-gnomonic fit. Gaia has been consumed as development; nine free parameters versus six coordinate values are explicitly not identified by those positions alone.
verified_scientific_accounting.counterfactual: The final-body G1 Taylor control preserves value/gradient/Hessian at the declared origin and changes only higher spatial variation; reported22.56mas and1.23e4s are fixed-body counterfactual differences, not a refit or unused test.

verified_scientific_accounting.prior_LCO_scores: Old and compact-source LCO coverage/scores remain associated with their original frozen geometries. They are not assigned to the new G1 model or counted as a fresh test.
verified_scientific_accounting.prior_HST_scope: Updated central-image ratios and approximately7.46conditional upper multipliers match the final application; consumed HST is not counted as unused validation.
verified_scientific_accounting.new_photon_independence: The once-only JWST diagnostic uses different2022photons after final point prediction freeze. Physical forecasts were unchanged through calibration failures and the pretarget diagnostic amendment.
verified_scientific_accounting.new_extraction_scope: Independent field PSF calibration fails; original validation is blocked. The later diagnostic uses fixed independent PSFs, predeclared quadratic backgrounds and field-only association corrections, with all validation flags forced false.
verified_scientific_accounting.reported_result_meaning: The76.48percent raw residual decrease is descriptive under the same inadequate extraction/errors. Formal Q5 and conditional p-values are not calibrated physical-model rejection or evidence for BHSM.
verified_scientific_accounting.microscopic_state_scope: Original j_c bilinear is not replaced by J_eff or an achieved current target. No U/V solution, vacuum, dressed-state factorization, Wick closure or quantum statistical kernel is inferred from the classical GP, retarded arrays or heat functional. Exclusive2pt/inclusivecontour4pt/complete matched occupations remain distinct.

remaining_conceptual_and_empirical_limit: An adequate source/visit-dependent instrumental mean, diffuse-host model and calibrated distortion/noise uncertainty have not been established. PSF/ERR failures leave centroid bias and sub-mas residual interpretation unresolved.

The single reference-star wings and tested finite response corrections do not uniquely identify wavefront, SED, image-motion, detector or illumination-history contributions or their transfer to quasar light.
The conditional nine-parameter development model is not a converged full posterior, uniquely measured G1 mass profile or complete galaxy/environment reconstruction.
Anchored quadratic-remainder convergence and positive G1 scale are declared conditional prescriptions; neither is an independently derived BHSM environmental state.
Finite image searches/projections and isolated-field matching do not complete globally constrained scalar/Cauchy domains or material support.
Canonical-field/cap embedding, microscopic source pairing and state contractions remain unresolved by this classical optical fit. The current manuscript states rather than hides that boundary.

No conventional or R1 model is precision-validated on this diagnostic, no BHSM preference or unique envelope-state map is established, and no unused band is substituted for the failed primary experiment.
